evidence.result: PASS, exit code 0. Five steps: first install via prepare-app --migrate on a temp DB; owner data seeded (companies, drafts, completed diagnoses, preferences); synthetic RedefineTables release applied; data identical after update; repeat deploy reports no pending migrations and the company->diagnoses cascade still works. Final line '[smoke-migrate] PASS'.

evidence.check: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit (whole project, supporting check for prismaClient.ts and testDatabase.ts)
Static review against the implementer's contract claims
evidence.result: server/db/prismaClient.ts exports createPrismaClient(databaseUrl = resolveDatabaseUrl()) and applies busy_timeout=5000, journal_mode=WAL and foreign_keys=ON on connect. tests/helpers/testDatabase.ts exports createTestDatabase(options) returning a flat TestDatabase; resetData() covers companies, diagnoses and preferences, which are the only three models in prisma/schema.prisma. scripts/prepare-app.mjs exports APP_ROOT and runPackageBin, runs the steps only when executed directly, and exits 2 on an unknown flag. The migration SQL creates the same three tables and the diagnoses_company_id_status_idx index that schema.prisma declares. better-sqlite3 is a direct dependency, so smoke-migrate.mjs resolves it. Agent-reported only; no separate runtime probe was run in this attempt.

The postinstall should run scripts/prepare-app.mjs --generate --migrate --build and succeed. Confirm the data/ folder and the generated Prisma client appear, and that no database is written unless DATABASE_URL is unset (it then uses data/fitpulse.db). This check was not run in QA.

Process observation outside this unit's scope (recorded as aioson observation OBS-af8fbe, risk): the implementer ran `cat .env` in its session, which printed the OPENROUTER_API_KEY value into session output. Nothing was written to a file. Consider rotating that key. No code change is needed for this unit.

AC-dm-45's 'datafile never travels in the published package' half is owned by scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs in your unit. Please confirm it covers data/ and prisma/*.db, and that it uses the APP_ROOT and runPackageBin exports from scripts/prepare-app.mjs as the implementer described.
